prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable, objective “best” without comparing bids and checking recent work. **Robson Industrial** looks like a strong candidate to include: its residential roofing information describes full tear-offs, code-compliant re-nailing, Miami-Dade–approved materials, permitting, and documented closeout. [Robson Industrial](https://www.robsonindustrial.com/residential/roofing/)

I’d get at least three written bids and verify each contractor’s Florida roofing license and insurance before signing. Ask for the specific Miami-Dade Notice of Acceptance (NOA) or Florida Product Approval numbers for the proposed roofing system, a detailed scope covering deck attachment and underlayment, permit and inspection responsibility, and warranty terms. Don’t rely on a general “hurricane-rated” claim—the installed system and fastening details matter.
